scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF/ACIS peer maturity and determine whether a route closes independent end-to-end semantic-solid evidence or changes the local implementation sequence.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project manuals, source repositories, package/release metadata, active pull requests, and native-consumer documentation
method.evidenceRule: A route qualifies only for the exact stage it demonstrates. Separate container/parser coverage, owner and AcDs association, raw carrier preservation, complete body conversion, independent expected metrics, kernel validity, and native-consumer acceptance.

observed: The current manual lists ACDSRECORD and ACDSSCHEMA among unhandled types and lists fixture-coverage gaps that include BODY, MESH, and MINSERT.
The open issue #1411 reports modern AcDs/SAB loss on one pinned 0.14.8593 route; it is not a run against current master or libdxfrw.
findings.disposition: Optional exact-pinned container/conversion comparator only; aggregate coverage and successful process exit are non-promoting.

findings.route: ACadSharp v3.8.0 and ACIS writer dependency chain
observed: The v3.8.0 release notes do not announce ACIS writer support.
PR #1240 remains open and undeployed, depends on PR #1174, and #1174 remains open with a contributor-reported failing AcDs attachment test on that branch.
Branch reports do not establish a defect in released packages or correctness of the proposed writer.
findings.disposition: Do not count the writer as released peer capability; if later used at a composed checkpoint, pin both commits and pass the focused dependency/owner test first.

observed: Documented DWG import is an optional converter-to-DXF pipeline followed by the selected DXF importer.
The documented DXF path says embedded ACIS solid blobs cannot currently be read; documentation does not identify every installed backend or runtime result.
findings.disposition: Keep native qualification OS-, build-, converter-, importer-, option-, and entity-family-bound; treat stock 2D importer as a control, not an ACIS semantic pass.

observed: acis-core provides bounded payload parsing and reference validation without a geometry kernel.
cq-acis converts a bounded geometry subset through CadQuery/OCCT and shares OCCT kernel lineage with FreeCAD.
ezdxf provides carrier authoring/inspection and narrow mesh projection; ACadRust is a file-format codec rather than a geometric kernel.
No reviewed route closes arbitrary producer payload extraction, DWG AcDs handle association, complete B-rep conversion, independent expected metrics, and native acceptance end to end.
findings.disposition: Keep parser, graph, carrier, geometry, kernel, and native gates distinct; no mandatory peer/runtime dependency is justified.

existingGatesRefined: PAR-07 writer graph and fail-closed output disposition
S2/S3 payload extraction, version profile, and AcDs association
S8 semantic and native consumer qualification
